detail.longDescription: I can see the "changes" pane which allows me to review the changes the agent has made, if I'm happy with the changes how do I git commit and push? Do I need to go back to the regular VS Code window to complete this (or am I forced to ask the agent to push for me)? Update: I'll add a screenshot since people seem to not know what an "Agents Window" is: The "changes" pane is on the right, and there's a button to "sync" my previously committed changes, but there doesn't appear to be any me to commit the changes without going back to the "Editor Window": My question was whether I am missing the functionality to commit the changes in the Agents Window or if I have to go back and forth.
